theCohortQuestion.asked: Three families fail REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and nothing else. Do two of them share one root, and is the third the same shape?
theCohortQuestion.answer: TWO PLUS ONE. The two Alabama families are one root, measured. New Jersey is a different defect on a different form with a different mechanism, and it is repaired on its own terms.
theCohortQuestion.andOneMore: The two roots are cousins rather than the same fault. Alabama's earlier root (FIX09) classified fields by matching the AcroForm field NAME with loose regexes. New Jersey's classifies them by matching the caption the geometry HARVESTED, and falls through to required-before-filing when it recognises nothing. Both decide a legal question -- whose blank is this -- from a string that was never meant to answer it.

theDefectReproducedOnTheDeliveredBytes.theRoot: classifyRefusal(name, label) decides OWNERSHIP from the caption the geometry happened to reach, and returns required_before_filing as its fall-through. The same fallible caption is then printed to the participant as the instruction. Where the harvest caught a trigger word the field became court/prosecutor/clerk/agency-owned; where it caught “The” or “at” or nothing, the same kind of field became a fact the participant must supply. Pages 37 and 42 show it at its clearest: the left column of the recipient block (Prosecutor, Chief of Police, Warden, Superintendent, Sheriff) is refused as agency-owned and the right column (Municipal Court Administrator, County Probation) is surfaced to the participant, on the same lines of the same block.

theRepair.mechanismUsed: The per-document caption table this host already provides, on its own stated terms: the caption the FORM PRINTS beside the named widget, read off the printed face and recorded, never re-derived by a cleverer rule. Family-scoped, because the same kit backs four other New Jersey families that are not in this lane's grant.
theRepair.one: A third caption-table shape, { caption, refusalClass, reason }. The existing COURT_USE_ONLY marker carries ONE reason and that reason is a sentence about a printed ‘FOR COURT USE ONLY’ rule; the New York MRTA form has such a rule and CN-10557 does not, and its wrongly-surfaced controls are wrong for four different true reasons. Using COURT_USE_ONLY would have put a sentence about a line that is not on the page into the delivered field map, which is the same class of defect as the caption being corrected. The object shape lets each row state its own trusted refusal class and its own true reason. The string and [COURT_USE_ONLY, caption] shapes are untouched, so no other family moves.
theRepair.two: Nineteen rows reclassified out of REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, each with the reason read off the form's own face or the repository's own record: orderHearYr, hearDay, hearTime, hearTimeM (the hearing the Court sets when it signs the Order for Hearing), sigHearJdg and sigFinalJdg (the judicial signature lines the kit tells filers to leave blank), orderFinalDay (the Expungement Order's own date), expungDocketNum (the kit prints ‘(leave blank - clerk will fill in)’ beside this same caption on pages 18, 27 and 30), CoverLtrEHearDt and CoverLtrEHearTime (Form E restating that court-set hearing), the eight cells of the monies-owed section, and sigNoticeDt (a signature date, written after the copies are actually mailed).
theRepair.three: Fifty printed captions for every blank that remains on the participant's list, each naming the words the form prints, the form and the page. Sixty-nine rows became fifty, and zero of the fifty display an internal field name.
theRepair.four: assertPrintedCaptionInvariants(), which runs at the end of every build AND again under --check, on the same field map and instructions the participant receives. Four conditions: every surfaced blank is named in the caption table, so a blank reaches a participant only after a person read its printed caption off the form; no surfaced row displays the form's own field name; nothing marked as its owner's is still counted as a fact to supply before filing; and every surfaced caption actually appears in participant-instructions.md. Opt-in per document (requiredBlanksCarryPrintedCaptions), because the other four New Jersey families and the two New York ones have not been through this pass and a check they cannot meet is a check that gets disabled.
theRepair.notRepairedAndSaidSo: The left/right split of the pages 37 and 42 recipient blocks is left alone and named in the code comment. Both columns are the same kind of blank; closing the split the other way would move rows that VF06 scored PASS on PROTECTED_FIELDS and SERVICE, and it is not this lane's finding.

A cold build with the committed production-field-map.json deleted -- so installedRefusalRows() carries nothing forward -- fails on contOwe, a row the warm build never surfaces. newJersey.somethingTheColdBuildRevealed: With no prior field map to carry forward, this family's map is NOT the same map. installedRefusalRows() deliberately preserves classifications an earlier repair lane installed, and several rows -- contOwe among them -- hold a classification that classifyRefusal would not reproduce from the builder and the source alone. The committed field map is therefore reproducible from builder + source + PRIOR MAP, and not from builder + source. That is the host's designed behaviour and this lane changed none of it, but it means a from-scratch reconstruction of this family would not match, and it is worth a lane of its own.

rows.rowText: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING repaired at its root on NJ-CN-10557. The delivered guide's list of ‘exact facts still required before filing’ carried 69 rows, of which nineteen were facts nobody can supply before filing -- the hearing the Court sets, both judicial signature lines, the two order dates, the docket number the kit itself says the clerk fills in, the eight cells of the monies-owed section that NJ.memo.json records as the court's to complete, and the participant's own signature date -- while the same file said three lines earlier that court, judge, clerk, hearing and post-order fields remain for their proper owners. Fourteen more displayed the form's internal field name as the instruction and others displayed a truncated fragment of a neighbouring printed line, three of them read off the wrong column. The root is classifyRefusal deciding ownership from a harvested caption and falling through to required-before-filing; the repair is the per-document printed-caption table this host already provides, extended with a shape that lets a row state its own trusted refusal class and its own true reason, plus assertPrintedCaptionInvariants() running after every build and under --check so no blank reaches a participant unless a person read its printed caption off the form. 69 rows became 50, none of them naming an internal field. No participant-facing PDF byte moved.

whatOutlivesTheseThree.finding: A packet family's committed field map is not reproducible from its builder and its source alone.
whatOutlivesTheseThree.detail: installedRefusalRows() deliberately carries an earlier repair lane's classifications forward across a rebuild, and checkOfficial() feeds the committed map back to itself as the carry-forward source, so the drift check proves reproducibility-given-the-map rather than reproducibility. Deleting nj_arrest_no_conviction-set's production-field-map.json and rebuilding produces a different map: contOwe, for one, holds a classification classifyRefusal would not reproduce. Everything committed is honest about this in comments, and nothing here is a defect in itself, but it means no lane can reconstruct a family from first principles and compare, and a classification whose original evidence is lost cannot be re-derived. Worth a lane.

whatOutlivesTheseThree.finding: checkOfficial() ran one finalize pass against twice-finalized delivered bytes.
whatOutlivesTheseThree.detail: Fixed in this lane because the new invariant needed --check to be reachable, and provably a no-op for every family that declares no repeatingRowGroups. The general lesson is larger: any second pass a build adds has to be added to its checker in the same commit, or the checker starts reporting drift on correct artifacts and gets ignored.

whatOutlivesTheseThree.finding: The completeness contract's field classes decide from a label regex, and a truthful caption can push a correctly-classified row into the wrong class.
whatOutlivesTheseThree.detail: COURT_ONLY matches any label containing ‘clerk’ or ‘judge’, so naming the Clerk of the Superior Court in the caption of a blank the PARTICIPANT fills would turn a correct REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING row into UNCLASSIFIED_BLANK. This lane wrote each caption as the printed words plus the location on the form, which is both the house convention and the truthful answer, and did not word anything to dodge a regex -- but the pressure to do so is real and a future lane will feel it. The classes should be reachable from a declaration, not only from a label.

whatOutlivesTheseThree.finding: The two-column recipient blocks on CN-10557 pages 37 and 42 are split between two ownership classes by an accident of caption capture.
whatOutlivesTheseThree.detail: Prosecutor, Chief of Police, Warden, Superintendent and Sheriff are refused as agency-owned; Municipal Court Administrator and County Probation are surfaced to the participant. They are the same kind of blank on the same lines. This lane made the surfaced half intelligible and left the split, because closing it would move rows VF06 scored PASS. Named here so it is not mistaken for settled.

whatOutlivesTheseThree.finding: Four Alabama families were already unbuildable here; this lane confirms the number is six.
whatOutlivesTheseThree.detail: al-felony-dwop-set and al-felony-nonconviction-90-set were forked out of the shared host but not off the shared SOURCE: both still pin CR-65 at the same path in the same absent custody.
